description: Earthquakes, volcano alerts and satellite fire detections in a bounding box, for display. Pass `bbox` [west, south, east, north] (WGS84), optional `types` (quake, volcano, fire; default all), `min_magnitude` (quakes, default 2.5) and `limit` (1 to 500, default 100). Earthquakes are USGS, magnitude 2.5 and above, past 24 hours, as reported (magnitudes and locations may be revised). Volcano alerts are USGS-monitored volcanoes ONLY: an absent alert says nothing about volcanoes elsewhere. Fire cells are NASA FIRMS VIIRS detections thinned to 0.5 degree cells: satellite-detected heat, NOT confirmed fires. Each feed carries `status` (ok, stale, unknown): pass a stale or unknown status on, never present old data as current. This is reported data for display, not a warning service and not safety-critical; keep that qualifier when you pass it on. Requires the MapMap gateway. Display the returned `attribution`, and for fire data the FIRMS `acknowledgment` and `disclaimer`.

bbox.description:
Bounding box `[west, south, east, north]`, WGS84 degrees. West must
be less than east and south less than north; a box crossing the
antimeridian is not supported (query two boxes).

limit.description:
Most events to return, 1 to 500 (default 100). Newest quakes
first, then volcano alerts, then the busiest fire cells.

min_magnitude.description:
Smallest earthquake magnitude, 2.5 to 9.0 (default 2.5). Quakes
only.

types.description:
Which feeds to include: any of `quake`, `volcano`, `fire`. Default:
all three.

name: events_in_area

EventOut.description: One earthquake, volcano alert or fire cell.

alert_level.description: Volcano: USGS alert level (NORMAL, ADVISORY, WATCH, WARNING).

cell_deg.description: Fire: the cell size in degrees (0.5).

color_code.description:
Volcano: USGS aviation colour code as a word (GREEN, YELLOW,
ORANGE, RED).

count.description: Fire: satellite detections inside the cell.

coverage.description:
Volcano: US-monitored volcanoes only; an absent alert says nothing
about volcanoes elsewhere.

derived.description: Fire: says the cell is derived from detections, not a fire.

high_confidence_share.description:
Fire: share of detections the satellite flags high confidence, 0
to 1.

id.description: The event's id (a fire cell id is `fire:<south>,<west>`).

label.description: Fire: "Satellite-detected heat, not confirmed fires". Keep it.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS84 degrees. A fire cell is its 0.5 degree cell centre.

mag.description: Quake: magnitude as reported (may be revised).

max_frp.description: Fire: the largest fire radiative power in the cell, megawatts.

place.description: Quake: USGS place description, e.g. "12 km SW of Ridgecrest, CA".

sent_at.description: Volcano: when the notice was sent, RFC 3339 UTC.

EventsFeedOut.description: One feed's freshness, as the gateway reports it.

age_s.description: Seconds since `fetched_at` when the gateway assembled the answer.

count_in_file.description: Events in the feed's file before the box and filters were applied.

detections.description: Fires only: raw satellite detections behind the thinned cells.

fetched_at.description: When the box last fetched the feed (RFC 3339), if known.

status.description:
`ok` (fetched within the threshold), `stale` (older; features are
still returned, so say they are paused) or `unknown` (no data for
this feed). Never present stale or unknown data as current.

threshold_s.description: The age in seconds after which the feed counts as stale.

acknowledgment.description: NASA FIRMS acknowledgment. Display it with fire data.

attribution.description: Source credits, keyed by feed. Display them.

coverage.description: What each feed does and does not cover. Pass it on.

disclaimer.description: NASA FIRMS "as is" disclaimer. Display it with fire data.

endorsement.description:
No endorsement by or affiliation with USGS, NOAA or NASA is
implied.

events.description: The events: newest quakes, then volcano alerts, then fire cells.

feeds.description: Freshness of each requested feed, keyed `quake`, `volcano`, `fire`.

label.description: Reported events for display; not a warning service. Pass it on.

summary.description: One sentence built from the counts. Pass it on with its qualifier.

truncated.description: True when the limit cut the list short.
